about: A sign-in service you run yourself, so people log in to your apps with passkeys instead of passwords.

prs.title: Long ID numbers now arrive with every digit intact
prs.broken: Admins can attach extra details to users, like a Discord ID. Long numbers came out with the last digits wrong, and 1000000 came out as "1e+06", which some apps rejected.
prs.changed: The sign-in service now keeps whole numbers exactly as they were saved.
prs.matters: Apps that rely on those details, for example to match a Discord account, get the right value.

prs.title: Removing someone from a group now reaches connected apps
prs.broken: When an admin removed a user from a group on the user's page, the apps kept in sync with the service were never told. The user stayed in that group there.
prs.changed: Saving a user's groups now marks the groups they left as changed too, so the next sync sends them.
prs.matters: When someone's access is taken away, it is taken away in the connected apps as well.
